about_the_game:
EcoBeat is a rhythm-based plogging game where players clean the ocean by tapping to the beat. Set against a vibrant shoreline, EcoBeat turns environmental action into a stylized musical journey, combining the thrill of rhythm games with a mission to restore our oceans.

🌊 The Ocean Gives Us Oxygen

Did you know that over 50% of the oxygen we breathe comes from the ocean? In EcoBeat, every piece of trash you collect helps regenerate marine life and boost oxygen levels. The more you clean, the more the sea heals, and the more rhythm you unlock.

🎵 Rhythm Meets Responsibility

Inspired by OSU-style gameplay, players tap along to catchy beats as they collect trash swept along the tide. Time your taps perfectly to chain combos, earn points, and bring the ocean back to life.

🎮 Core Features

  • Tap-to-the-beat rhythm gameplay with a unique ocean clean-up theme

  • Immersive art and sound that reflect the health of the sea

  • Playable without internet—anytime, anywhere

  • Tracks that evolve with your progress—unlock new music and zones

  • A peaceful but engaging gameplay experience that supports environmental awareness

🌱 Game With Purpose

EcoBeat isn’t just about rhythm;it’s about rhythm with meaning. We believe small actions can lead to big change. Whether you’re a rhythm game pro or new to the genre, EcoBeat offers a joyful, healing way to play for the planet.

Break the silence. Beat for the Earth. Clean the sea. One tap at a time.
